targets.title: Time and Poverty in Western Welfare States: United Germany in Perspective.
targets.evidence_quote: This article replicates Leisering and Leibfried’s study using statistical data about social assistance claiming in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.
targets.outcome_quote: Our findings partly corroborate Leisering and Leibfried’s outcomes with regards to the factors contributing to longer benefit spells, but with one important difference.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors reject the main temporal-poverty and recurrence claims but explicitly partly corroborate the original results for factors explaining duration, with a contrast for immigrant status. The discussion refutes the temporary-poverty general claim rather than supplying an overall verdict on every tested finding.
